Notes: Key of Heads = head id, same as UModLuaLibrary.GetCharacterHeadId.
ParamId = slider id of GetCharacterShapeParams / SetCharacterShapeParam.
A head id missing from Heads has no face point data (face points not supported on that head). Each head lists its own Sliders; do not assume the same count or order on every head.
Positions and deltas are in cm, head mesh component space, reference pose. AxisLateral = character's left (H), AxisUp (V), AxisForward = face forward (D).
Point position = RefPosition + sum over Columns of (value - Default) * (DeltaPerUnitPos if value >= Default else DeltaPerUnitNeg).

World position = (current world transform of bone HeadBone) * inverse(HeadBoneRef) * point position. HeadBoneRef is that bone's reference-pose transform in component space; Rotation is a quaternion X, Y, Z, W.
Solve = true: the official editor moves this slider when the point is dragged; false: the column is only used to compute the point's current position (sliders of other regions also move it).
Axes = directions the point can be dragged on this head. Keep slider values inside max(Min, SafeMin)..min(Max, SafeMax).

Slider Side: 1 = affects the character's left side only, -1 = right only, 0 = both; slider Mirror = the slider of the other side. Point Side: 1 = point on the character's left, -1 = right, 0 = middle; point Mirror = the point on the other side.
